contractReview.title: Contract Review
contractReview.reviewDescription: Review and update the status of this contract
contractReview.statusGuideDescription: Use these images as a reference to determine the correct contract status
contractReview.notFoundHint: Mark as {status} if the contract cannot be found in-game
contractReview.completedHint: Mark as {status} if the contract has been fulfilled
contractReview.failedHint: Mark as {status} if the contract has expired or been cancelled
contractReview.howToUseDescription: A guide to help you efficiently review and categorize contracts
contractReview.purposeBody: This tool helps moderators review contracts with abyssal modules to determine their current status. By accurately categorizing contracts, we can improve our AI training data and provide better market insights to users.
contractReview.step1Body: Use the "Copy Link" button to copy a formatted link that you can paste into EVE Online's notepad.
contractReview.step2Body: Paste the link in EVE Online's notepad and click it to open the contract.
contractReview.step3Body: Use the images above to determine the correct status.
contractReview.step4Body: Click the appropriate button to mark the contract as Completed, Failed, or Unknown.
contractReview.step5Body: After updating the status, a new contract will automatically load and its link will be copied to your clipboard.
contractReview.tip1: If you're unsure about a contract's status, mark it as "Unknown" and move on.
contractReview.tip2: For contracts that can't be found, mark them as "Failed" with the reason "Not Found".
contractReview.tip3: Take your time to be accurate, quality data is more important than quantity.
contractReview.noticeBody: All contract status submissions are reviewed for accuracy. Malicious or intentional misuse of this tool will result in a permanent ban from our services.
contractReview.noContractsBody: There are no contracts to review at this time.
contractReview.confirmBody: Are you sure you want to mark Contract #{id} as {status}?
contractReview.instructionsDescription: Please read and acknowledge the instructions before using this tool
contractReview.acknowledge: I have read and understand the instructions
contractReview.copyFailedBody: Failed to copy contract to clipboard
contractReview.idCopiedBody: Contract ID {id} has been copied to your clipboard
contractReview.linkCopiedBody: Contract link for {name} has been copied to your clipboard
